item.tib: stag la bdag rdzogs gis sgrub pa las bsad pa'i mtshon cha rno ngar spu gri
item.coloph: gsang ba'i man ngag kun la mi bstan/ gcig la mi bsnub pa'i gsang rgya yod/ khro bo stag la me 'bar gyi sgrub thabs/ srung zlog bsad pa'i dang chas (pa dang bcas) pa 'di ni/ stag la me 'bar gyi (gyis) lha klu mi gsum gshen la brgyud/ de gsum gyi (gyis) nam mkha' snang ba mdog can la brgyud/ des dran pa nam mkha' la brgyud/ des dmu tsha gyer med la brgyud/ des blo ldan snying po la brgyud do//
